Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientConnection, Runnable
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements Runnable, ClientConnection
============================================================================ SocketClientHandler — Handler for a TCP connection for a client ============================================================================ ROLE: - Separate thread for each client connected via TCP Socket - Reads Requests from the client and forwards them to the Controller (single game) - Implements ClientConnection (sendUpdate) and ClientHandler - Manages the heartbeat system (ping/pong) to detect disconnections PING-PONG PATTERN: - Ping every 5 seconds (PING_INTERVAL_MS) - If no Pong is received within 15 seconds (PING_TIMEOUT_MS): 1. Calls controller.markDisconnected() -> notifies other players 2. Calls disconnect() -> closes the socket and cleans up ============================================================================

    • run

      public void run()
      Main thread loop: opens streams and reads Requests from the client as long as the connection is active, applying a two-level dispatch (PongResponse and JoinGameRequest handled immediately, other Requests via execute()). Upon closure or in case of error, disconnects the client.
